title: Six of Knapp's corroborating witnesses were threatened into silence
summary: Luigi Vendetelli tells of Six of Knapp's corroborating witnesses were threatened into silence, about 1989 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he says they all received the phone call, they were all threatened and they never went public.

plain: A researcher named Luigi Vendetelli relays what George Knapp, a Las Vegas journalist, told him about Bob Lazar, a man who said in 1989 that he had worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. According to Knapp, six other people who could have backed up Lazar's story all got phone calls, were threatened, and never went public, which, if true, would mean someone worked to keep the story from being confirmed.
